name: kb_rectangular_matmul
description: Rectangular matrix multiplication C = A @ B where A is M×K and B is K×N. This represents the general matmul case with three independent dimensions. Unlike square matmul, the aspect ratios (M:K:N) significantly impact performance - tall-skinny, short-wide, and reduction-heavy cases require different optimization strategies. Key challenges: load balancing across non-square tiles, handling different M/N/K ratios, and optimizing for varying compute vs memory bottlenecks.
